root: ^We grew up in the slums, surrounded by the tormented souls of both the dead and the living.
^Our mother tried her best, raising a set of twins on her own couldn't have been easy.
^She worked herself to death soon after our 8th birthday
^After that you were my rock, although I was technically older, You raised me. You got us off the streets. Got me this job.
^I owe everything to you. But I dont remember if I had ever said thank you.
^But I guess its too late for that now...
^Emma was a beloved Sister, Fiancé, doctor, and a friend to us all. Good spirits and people alike were drawn to her.
^Her smile and charm were second to only her determination.
^Her determination to, no matter the odds, make a positive impact on those lucky enough to have crossed paths with her.
^As we know death is not the end for our souls voyage, and as she transcends into her spirited form
^I know she will continue to make the world itself a better place.
